senses.gloss:
मिह् मिह् (for original मिघ्), i. 1, Par.
 1. To sprinkle.
 2. To urine, Chr. 290, 6 = Rigv. i. 64, 6; Man. 4, 52.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. Par. मीढ्वंस् (ved.), also before vowels, मीऌह्˚ for मीढ्˚, One who effuses or gives, Lass. 100, 1 = Rigv. vii. 15, 1.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. मीढ.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, प्रमीढ,
 1. Passed, as urine.
 2. Thick.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To sprinkle, to give, Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16. (मिमिक्ष्व, imperat. ii. 3, Ātm. or anomal. desider.). Desider. मिमिक्ष, To wish to mix, to unite one's self, Chr. 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 87, 6 (मिमिक्षिरे, anomal. pf. red.).
 --Cf. Lat. mingere, mejere; A.S. mígan; Goth. maihstus; A.S. meox, miox, mist; ὁμίχλη, ὀμιχεῖν, μοιχός, μιαίνω, μιαρός.

मिहिर मिहिर, m.
 1. i. e. मिह् + इर, A cloud.
 2. (borrowed from the Persian language), The sun.
 3. The moon.
 4. Wind.
 5. A proper name.
मिहिलारोप्य मिहिलारोप्य, n. The name of a town, Pañc. 3, 9.
